There are two modules. app/wear. You just install "app" when select in Android Studio

Basically BlueoothGlucoseMeter is the class which communicates to the "guide me". 

**- if (queue.isEmpty()) {**
This is where we add all the characteristics we are interested.  . So you can change the list here. I am interested in only "Accu Check Guide Me".  Problem is Accucheck don't have GLUCOSE CONTEXT characteristic.  So we need to delete that., like they did for "Diamond Mobile Mini".

 _If I don't delete this characteristic, I am not getting any data., as the program stuck is queue ( I think, I may be wrong)_

Main command which get the data from the device is .

_**Bluetooth_CMD.write(GLUCOSE_SERVICE, RECORDS_CHARACTERISTIC, RecordsCmdTx.getAllRecords(), "request all readings");**_

Hope this helps, let me know if you need more info.

Hi again 

the sensor sends the data without indication of the number of data inside it
is there any indication of the size data it gives ? (Number of data to wait )

here is some standard BLE commands 

 * [1,1] Read all records
 * [4,1] Number of records
 * [1,6] Read last record received
 * [1,5] Read first record
 * [1,3,1,45,0] Read extract from record 45 onwards
